Now the build gates:All verification complete. Here's my audit report:

## Audit report — `20260810223554-xoxfjg.md` (FIX MEDIUM: unquoted padded secrets + binary additions)

**Objective**: pre-push hook + inline scanner miss `password = hunter2` (whitespace-padded unquoted) and binary additions are never scanned.

**Evidence gathered (all independently reproduced):**

1. **Hook regex fix** — `dracon-warden/src/main.rs` PRE_PUSH_HOOK now defines `SECRET_RE` (3 hits) including `password\s*=\s*[^[:space:]"']{6,}`. Commit 3e48007 diff shows the old inline regex (quote required after `=`) extracted and extended. Regex semantics verified: `password = hunter2` matches (7-char value ≥ 6), quoted forms unchanged.

2. **Binary-added scan** — commit 3e48007 adds `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A -z "$RANGE"` + per-file `git cat-file blob "$local_sha:$af" | grep -aqE "$SECRET_RE"`, with `.plaintext` hatch skip and modified files left on added-lines-only scan. Code comments correctly note `git diff --unified=0` emits no `+` lines for binaries.

3. **Inline scanner fix** — commit 1c25c66 in `src/security/src/modules/scanner.rs`: re-enabled "Generic Secret (Unquoted)" (was commented out upstream) with `\b` boundaries + `\s*=\s*`; "Password Variable (Unquoted)" now `\s*=\s*` + `{6,}`; three other unquoted patterns gained `\s*` tolerance.

4. **Tests** — 6 new tests (3 in tests.rs, 3 in scanner_edge_cases_test.rs), all present with concat-split literals to avoid self-tripping the hook. **I ran them**: `pre_push_hook` filtered suite = 10 passed (incl. all 3 new), full bin suite = 101 passed, dracon-security = 45+4+1 plus 11 edge-case tests, all green.

5. **Gates** — I ran `cargo build --release --locked` (clean) and `cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings` (clean).

6. **Live E2E through the installed hook** — `~/.config/git/hooks/pre-push` (installed, 3× SECRET_RE, 1× diff-filter=A) and refreshed `~/.local/bin/dracon-warden` v0.113.4. I reproduced: clean text push passed; `password = hunter2` push **blocked** (exit 1, warning); AKIA-in-binary (NUL-containing) push **blocked**; clean binary push **passed** in a fresh repo (my first "clean binary blocked" result was a range artifact — the repo still held un-pushed secret commits; the fresh-repo run passes).

7. **Ledger/hygiene** — findings.md line 62 (exact objective text) flipped `[x]` → fixed in 741159b; all three mirrors (origin/codeberg/gitlab) at `741159b` for the warden repo and agree at `1181fb48f` for the parent (moved by this audit run's own progress commit). Reject-class check: no test spawns the test runner; all use temp repos + `run_hook` — no recursion risk.

**Minor non-blocking notes**: modified binaries still get only the added-lines diff scan (binaries show no `+` lines) — but the finding scoped "binary additions", which are now covered; the blob scan also re-checks added text files, which the code comment acknowledges as equivalent coverage for additions.

The objective is satisfied: both miss paths are closed in source, installed artifact, and live behavior; tests and gates are real and reproducible.

<approved/>
